# Polynomial Factor Matching Checkpoint

Task `help_f9e206b7fe0e41e49174596683c59e8c`, revision 0, digest
`69a477346b36b5e12d649fb0d1c2018b53397328287b890fc83c4396eef79ea5`.
The assigned polynomial factor matching question is proved over every field,
which includes the requested specialization to rational polynomials.

## Saved Helpers

`Submission.Helpers.polynomial_dvd_of_irreducible_mul_eq_sq`,
`Submission/Helpers.lean:3658`:

```lean
{k : Type*} [Field k] {P Q G : Polynomial k}
(hP : Irreducible P) (hsq : G ^ 2 = P * Q) : P ∣ Q
```

Primality of the irreducible polynomial gives `P ∣ G`. Substitute `G=P*H`,
cancel the nonzero factor `P`, and obtain `Q=P*H^2`.

`Submission.Helpers.polynomial_eq_of_monic_irreducible_mul_eq_sq`,
`Submission/Helpers.lean:3669`:

```lean
{k : Type*} [Field k] {P Q G : Polynomial k}
(hP : P.Monic) (hPirr : Irreducible P) (hQ : Q.Monic)
(hdegree : Q.natDegree = P.natDegree)
(hsq : G ^ 2 = P * Q) : Q = P
```

Apply the preceding divisibility lemma and the library theorem
`Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le`. Irreducibility of `Q`
is not needed. All inherited declarations, proofs, imports, options and
namespace context are preserved. No probe commands remain.

## Validation

The frozen `check_lean` check of final saved `Submission.lean` passed:
exitCode 0, timedOut false. It compiled Helpers uncached in 31536 ms and
Submission uncached in 6117 ms. Helpers had no diagnostics. Submission
reported only its preserved original `dimitrov` sorry warning.
`git diff --check` passed.

Final Helpers SHA256:
`70fe5882f4b41086aa4ad07b7a19b28a75300b9d0cafae08834e3e4b0d51e178`.
Unchanged Submission SHA256:
`4ccc782999c50bb2bfb202882f675c6c2dc34fa54fbe1609796c781e9177b84e`.
No git commit was created; git metadata is managed by the host.

## Integration And Remaining Gaps

The host should independently check and integrate the two new named helpers,
then specialize the second to the monic reverses of the transform factors.
Their monicity, equal degrees and first-factor irreducibility must still be
established at that application site. No second-factor irreducibility is
required.

All recovered helpers, including argument positivity and exact argument
halving in the degree-drop case, remain in place and compiled in this run.
The original `Submission.dimitrov` remains unproved. Sharp arbitrary-ray
energy, quantitative contraction, reciprocal-minpoly identification and
final number-field/induction integration remain outside this assignment.
Original-target acceptance and independent official local evaluation are
not claimed.

theorem even_odd_polynomial_decomposition (F : Polynomial ℤ) :
    F = (Polynomial.contract 2 F).comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) +
      Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX F)).comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) := by
  change F = Polynomial.expand ℤ 2 (Polynomial.contract 2 F) +
    Polynomial.X * Polynomial.expand ℤ 2 (Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX F))
  ext n
  rw [Polynomial.coeff_add]
  cases n with
  | zero =>
      simp [Polynomial.coeff_expand (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℕ)),
        Polynomial.coeff_contract (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
  | succ n =>
      rw [Polynomial.coeff_X_mul,
        Polynomial.coeff_expand (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℕ)),
        Polynomial.coeff_expand (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℕ))]
      by_cases hn : 2 ∣ n
      · have hs : ¬ 2 ∣ n + 1 := by omega
        simp only [if_neg hs, if_pos hn, zero_add,
          Polynomial.coeff_contract (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0),
          Polynomial.coeff_divX]
        congr 1
        omega
      · have hs : 2 ∣ n + 1 := by omega
        simp only [if_pos hs, if_neg hn, add_zero,
          Polynomial.coeff_contract (by norm_num : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)]
        congr 1
        omega
changes.name: even_odd_polynomial_decomposition

theorem even_odd_power_transform_subst (F : Polynomial ℤ) :
    (((Polynomial.contract 2 F) ^ 2 -
      Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX F)) ^ 2).comp
        (Polynomial.X ^ 2)) = F * F.comp (-Polynomial.X) := by
  let A := Polynomial.contract 2 F
  let B := Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX F)
  have hF : F = A.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) +
      Polynomial.X * B.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) := even_odd_polynomial_decomposition F
  have hneg : F.comp (-Polynomial.X) = A.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) -
      Polynomial.X * B.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) := by
    calc
      _ = (A.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) +
          Polynomial.X * B.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2)).comp (-Polynomial.X) :=
        congrArg (fun P : Polynomial ℤ => P.comp (-Polynomial.X)) hF
      _ = _ := by
        simp only [Polynomial.add_comp, Polynomial.mul_comp,
          Polynomial.comp_assoc, Polynomial.pow_comp, Polynomial.X_comp, neg_sq]
        ring
  change (A ^ 2 - Polynomial.X * B ^ 2).comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) = _
  calc
    _ = (A.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) + Polynomial.X * B.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2)) *
        (A.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) - Polynomial.X * B.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2)) := by
      simp only [Polynomial.sub_comp, Polynomial.pow_comp,
        Polynomial.mul_comp, Polynomial.X_comp]
      ring
    _ = F * F.comp (-Polynomial.X) := congrArg₂ (fun P Q : Polynomial ℤ => P * Q)
      hF.symm hneg.symm

theorem power_argument_card_le {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (α : K) (k : ℕ) :
    (Finset.univ.image fun σ : K →+* ℂ ↦ (σ (α ^ k)).arg).card ≤
      (Finset.univ.image fun σ : K →+* ℂ ↦ (σ α).arg).card := by
  classical
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun θ => (k • (θ : Real.Angle)).toReal
  have harg (σ : K →+* ℂ) : (σ (α ^ k)).arg = f (σ α).arg := by
    rw [map_pow]
    exact Complex.arg_coe_angle_eq_iff_eq_toReal.mp
      (Complex.arg_pow_coe_angle (σ α) k)
  have himage : (Finset.univ.image fun σ : K →+* ℂ ↦ (σ (α ^ k)).arg) =
      (Finset.univ.image fun σ : K →+* ℂ ↦ (σ α).arg).image f := by
    rw [Finset.image_image]
    apply Finset.image_congr
    intro σ _
    exact harg σ
  rw [himage]
  exact Finset.card_image_le

theorem radial_green_fourier_series (ξ θ : ℝ) (hξ : 0 < ξ)
    (hθ : θ ∈ Set.Icc (-2 * Real.pi) (2 * Real.pi)) :
    Summable (fun n : ℤ => Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ) / (ξ ^ 2 + (n : ℝ) ^ 2)) ∧
      (∑' n : ℤ, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ) / (ξ ^ 2 + (n : ℝ) ^ 2)) =
        Real.pi * Real.cosh (ξ * (Real.pi - |θ|)) / (ξ * Real.sinh (Real.pi * ξ)) := by
  refine ⟨radial_cos_resolvent_summable ξ θ hξ, ?_⟩
  let x := |θ| / (2 * Real.pi)
  have hx : 0 ≤ x := by positivity
  have hθabs : |θ| ≤ 2 * Real.pi := abs_le.mpr ⟨by nlinarith [hθ.1], hθ.2⟩
  have hx' : x ≤ 1 := (div_le_one (by positivity : 0 < 2 * Real.pi)).mpr hθabs
  have hm : (2 * Real.pi * ξ) * x = ξ * |θ| := by
    dsimp only [x]
    field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
  have hrate : 2 * Real.pi * ξ = 2 * (Real.pi * ξ) := by ring
  have hcos (n : ℤ) : Real.cos (2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ) * x) =
      Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ) := by
    have hn : 2 * Real.pi * (n : ℝ) * x = (n : ℝ) * |θ| := by
      dsimp only [x]
      field_simp [Real.pi_ne_zero]
    rw [hn]
    by_cases hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg hθ0]
    · rw [abs_of_neg (lt_of_not_ge hθ0), mul_neg, Real.cos_neg]
  have hp := radial_resolvent_periodization ξ x hξ
  rw [radial_exp_periodization (2 * Real.pi * ξ) x (by positivity) hx hx'] at hp
  simp_rw [hcos] at hp
  have hhyper :
      (Real.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * ξ) * x) +
        Real.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * ξ) + (2 * Real.pi * ξ) * x)) /
          (1 - Real.exp (-(2 * Real.pi * ξ))) =
      Real.cosh (ξ * (Real.pi - |θ|)) / Real.sinh (Real.pi * ξ) := by
    rw [show ξ * (Real.pi - |θ|) = Real.pi * ξ - ξ * |θ| by ring,
      radial_cosh_periodic_decay (Real.pi * ξ) (ξ * |θ|) (by positivity)]
    rw [neg_mul, hm, hrate]
  have hscale := hp.trans hhyper
  have hsinh : Real.sinh (Real.pi * ξ) ≠ 0 :=
    (Real.sinh_pos_iff.mpr (by positivity : 0 < Real.pi * ξ)).ne'
  field_simp [hξ.ne', Real.pi_ne_zero, hsinh] at hscale ⊢
  simpa only [mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hscale

all temporary probes, proposition definitions and the temporary Reverse
import were removed. Both Lean files have no diff from the assigned seed.

Helpers SHA256 `8484c0bb3a467409613c685ea37085ebb99a5329930ecb8913ecee8137cb3096`.
No checker is running; git diff --check passes.

The main simplification is to reverse the polynomial square-product identity
and use monic equal-degree matching. The second transform need not be proved
irreducible or factored on the main proof path. The first reciprocal-minpoly
identification, degree descent, direction halving and quantitative integration
remain unsaved Lean obligations. The sharp arbitrary-ray bound is also open.

## Complete Mathematical Chain

Write `d(a) = (minpoly Q a).natDegree`, `m(a)` for the original argument-image
cardinality, `R = house a`, `F = (minpoly Z a).reverse`, and
`T(P) = (contract 2 P)^2 - X*(contract 2 (divX P))^2`.
Use distinct minpoly roots, or Q(a), when forming products: all embeddings of
a larger ambient K repeat each root `[K:Q(a)]` times. An even repetition
makes a polynomial-square argument uninformative.

1. The tower Q subset Q(a^2) subset Q(a) has upper degree 1 or 2, because a
   satisfies `X^2-C(a^2)`. Hence `d(a)=d(a^2)` or `d(a)=2*d(a^2)`.
   All these intermediate fields are finite dimensional over Q. This is the
   existing degree-dichotomy task, not a proved result of this research turn.
2. For any integer polynomial P, T preserves natDegree and has constant
   coefficient `P.coeff 0 ^ 2`. Also
   `T(P).eval2 f (z^2)=P.eval2 f z * P.eval2 f (-z)` for every ring map f.
   Both facts were kernel-proved in temporary probes. For nonzero integral
   a, F has constant coefficient 1, degree d(a), and root `a^-1`.
3. If `d(a^2)=d(a)`, put G=T(F). The polynomial G.reverse is monic, has degree
   d(a), and has a^2 as root: apply the evaluation identity at `a^-1`, then
   the reciprocal evaluation lemma. Map to Q and apply minimal-polynomial
   uniqueness to obtain `G.reverse = minpoly Z (a^2)`, hence
   `G = (minpoly Z (a^2)).reverse`. The Q/Z identification uses integral
   closedness; reversal is involutive here because the constant coefficients
   of the original minpolys are nonzero. No factorization result is assumed.
4. Put H=T(G). Suppose `S^2=(G*H).map Z_to_Q`. Reverse this equality, using
   multiplicativity of reverse. Set `P=(G.map Z_to_Q).reverse` and
   `Q=(H.map Z_to_Q).reverse`. Then P is the monic irreducible minpoly of a^2;
   Q is monic of the same degree. From P dividing `(S.reverse)^2`, primality
   gives P dividing S.reverse. Write S.reverse=P*U and cancel the nonzero P
   in `P*Q=P*(P*U^2)` to get P dividing Q. Equal degrees and monicity give
   P=Q. This generic square-product matching was kernel-proved temporarily.
5. H.reverse has a^4 as root by the same reciprocal evaluation identity.
   Thus the common irreducible monic P is also `minpoly Q (a^4)`, and
   `minpoly Q (a^2)=minpoly Q ((a^2)^2)`. Equal minpolys give equal houses;
   exact power compatibility gives `house(a^2)=house(a^2)^2`, so
   `house(a^2)<=1`. The power a^2 is still integral, nonzero and not of finite
   order, by `isOfFinOrder_pow`; this contradicts the retained house_gt_one.
   Equivalently Kronecker gives finite order of a^2 and then of a.
6. In the first degree-drop case, `d(a)=2*d(a^2)`. The monic polynomial
   `(minpoly Q (a^2)).comp (X^2)` has a as root and exactly degree d(a), so
   minimal-polynomial uniqueness gives equality with minpoly Q a. Its roots
   are closed under negation. Nonzero unit directions therefore form opposite
   pairs; squaring identifies exactly each pair, and full ambient embedding
   ranges realize both root sets. Consequently `m(a)=2*m(a^2)`. Induct on
   d(a), in the same ambient K, and use house_pow_le to obtain
   `2 <= house(a^2)^(4*m(a^2)) <= (R^2)^(4*m(a^2)) = R^(4*m(a))`.
   This last inequality conversion was kernel-proved temporarily.
7. For the preserved-degree contradiction under `R^(4*m(a))<2`, enumerate

{"taskId":"radial_energy_bridge_research","conclusion":"inconclusive","summary":"# Dimitrov Energy Bridge Checkpoint

## Assignment And Status

Research task `radial_energy_bridge_research`, revision 3, digest
`b35f008d9c1dbe34e2d0d86fa0f7334e13360408974efb4ca027621878e06a7a`.
No Lean declaration is delivered. Both owned Lean files have been restored
byte-for-byte to canonical commit `31d7694fe91c7c953a6de0786de8fc76bf3714e2`.
The original `Submission.dimitrov` still contains its sorry.

The saved Green Fourier identity at Helpers.lean:3352 and angular Green
bound at :2995 are the starting point. The interval theorem at :2444,
compact uniformization at :3059, empirical reduction at :3126 and
conditional Fekete estimate at :2565 remain useful. The complete saved
module was independently compiled in this turn. Cooperation records the
Green identity integrated; it does not record the absent radial comparison
or original-target acceptance.

## Exact Comparison And Spectral Constants

For m>0 distinct angles theta_i in [0,2*pi), use
X = Fin m x [0,T], z(i,t)=exp(-t)*exp(I*theta_i), and r(i,t)=exp(-m*t).
For a probability mu on X, define B=integral min(t,u) d(mu x mu),
Q_k=integral exp(-k*|t-u|)*cos(k*(theta_i-theta_j)) d(mu x mu),
and R_k=integral exp(-m*k*|t-u|) d(mu x mu), for integers k>=1.
The desired extended energy comparison is
I_ray(mu) >= I_interval(r_*mu)/m. It is an integrated comparison;
a pointwise comparison of distances on different rays is false.

The Green and angular bounds give, for xi>0 and any complex w_i,
S_k=norm(sum_i w_i*exp(I*k*theta_i))^2 and
`sum_{k>=1} (S_k+S_-k)/(2*(xi^2+k^2))
 >= S_0*sum_{k>=1} 1/(xi^2+(m*k)^2)`.
Both real series are summable. Obtain this by expanding the full integer
Green sum, applying the angular inequality, then subtracting the equal
zero-mode terms S_0/xi^2. The scalar full sum is
pi/(m*xi*tanh(pi*xi/m)), using the Green identity at xi/m and angle zero.
The factor m^(-2) from scaling the resolvent is essential.

For w_i(v)=integral over the i-th ray of exp(I*v*t) dmu, write
M_k(v)=sum_i w_i(v)*exp(I*k*theta_i). The exact mode identity is
`Q_k/k = (1/(2*pi))*integral_v
 (norm(M_k(v))^2+norm(M_-k(v))^2)/(k^2+v^2)`.
It implies 0<=Q_k<=1. With k replaced by m*k and no angular phase,
`R_k/(m*k)=(1/pi)*integral_v norm(M_0(v))^2/((m*k)^2+v^2)`.
Pair the positive and negative angular modes: their norm squares need not
be equal at a fixed v. The paired formula handles this directly.

Per-mode Fubini is absolutely justified by the Cauchy majorant
1/(k^2+v^2) on volume x mu x mu; the probability factors have total mass
one. The saved `radial_cauchy_kernel_integrable_unscaled` and
`radial_cauchy_kernel_inverse` supply the required integrability and
normalization. Fourier moment measurability and the product-integrability
proof still need to be written. Remove the zero mode before radial
integration: its 1/v^2 term is not integrable at zero. The comparison is
applied with xi=|v| for v!=0; the exceptional singleton is Lebesgue null.

Nonnegative Tonelli then proves
`sum' ofReal(R_k/(m*k)) <= sum' ofReal(Q_k/k)` in ENNReal,
with no finite-energy assumption. An infinite REAL tsum is unsuitable:
it becomes zero when nonsummable. Extracting a finite partial sum gives
the third closed task below, even for atomic mu.

## Finite Logarithmic Route

It suffices to prove the annular cutoff comparison below. This avoids
any untruncated Bochner log integral, harmonic-series convergence at the
diagonal, or interchange of an undamped real logarithmic series.

For a fixed interval cutoff L and error e>0, let epsilon=exp(-L).
Put b=min(t,u), q=exp(-m*|t-u|), d=exp(-m*b)*(1-q).
Choose 0<rho<1 with 1-rho <= (exp(e)-1)*epsilon.
Then D_rho=exp(-m*b)*(1-rho*q) satisfies
0<D_rho <= exp(e)*max(epsilon,d), since b>=0. Thus
`-log(max(epsilon,d)) <= m*b-log(1-rho*q)+e`.
The retained finite logTaylor approximation at angle zero has uniform
error at most rho^(P+1)/(1-rho). Choose P to make this error small.
Dropping the factors rho^k only increases its nonnegative interval
polynomial. After integration, I_L(interval)/m is bounded above by
B plus a FINITE sum of R_k/(m*k), with arbitrarily small error.

Use the finite-mode comparison to dominate this by B plus a finite sum
of Q_k/k. Choose a new Abel parameter r near one so the corresponding
finite weighted sum r^k*Q_k/k changes by arbitrarily little and
-log(r)/2 is small. Positivity of all Q_k permits increasing the Taylor
degree after choosing r. The saved finite complex Taylor estimate then
bounds the integrated Abel ray kernel from below with uniform error.

For the ray Abel kernel, set q=exp(-|t-u|), b=min(t,u),
D_r=exp(-b)*norm(1-r*q*exp(I*(theta_i-theta_j))).
The checked scalar identity is
`norm(1-r*q*exp(I*a))^2-r*norm(1-q*exp(I*a))^2
 =(1-r)*(1-r*q^2) >= 0`.
Hence D_r>=sqrt(r)*dist(z(i,t),z(j,u)) and
D_r>=exp(-T)*(1-r). Choose N with
sqrt(r)*exp(-N)

Determine and verify the exact comparison with the interval pushforward exp(-m*t), divided by m. theorem adjoin_power_degree_le_two {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] (α : K) :
    Module.finrank ℚ (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {α}) ≤
      2 * Module.finrank ℚ (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {α ^ 2}) := by
  let E : IntermediateField ℚ K := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {α}
  let F : IntermediateField ℚ K := IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {α ^ 2}
  let : Algebra ℚ E := E.algebra'
  let : Algebra ℚ F := F.algebra'
  have hFE : F ≤ E := by
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr
    simpa only [pow_two] using E.mul_mem
      (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ α)
      (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ α)
  let : Algebra F E := (IntermediateField.inclusion hFE).toRingHom.toAlgebra
  let : IsScalarTower ℚ F E := IsScalarTower.of_algHom (IntermediateField.inclusion hFE)
  let : FiniteDimensional ℚ E := IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_left E
  let : FiniteDimensional ℚ F := IntermediateField.finiteDimensional_left F
  let : FiniteDimensional F E := FiniteDimensional.right ℚ F E
  let a : E := IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ α
  let b : F := IntermediateField.AdjoinSimple.gen ℚ (α ^ 2)
  have hprim : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {a} = ⊤ := by
    apply IntermediateField.lift_injective E
    rw [IntermediateField.lift_adjoin_simple, IntermediateField.lift_top]
    rfl
  have hquad : Polynomial.aeval a (Polynomial.X ^ 2 - Polynomial.C b) = 0 := by
    simp only [map_sub, map_pow, Polynomial.aeval_X, Polynomial.aeval_C]
    apply Subtype.ext
    change α ^ 2 - α ^ 2 = 0
    exact sub_self _
  have hupper : Module.finrank F E ≤ 2 := by
    have hdegree := IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank (IsIntegral.of_finite F a)
    rw [IntermediateField.adjoin_eq_top_of_adjoin_eq_top ℚ hprim,
      IntermediateField.finrank_top'] at hdegree
    rw [hdegree]
    have hbound := Polynomial.natDegree_le_natDegree
      (minpoly.min F a (Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C b (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)) hquad)
    simpa only [Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C] using hbound
  change Module.finrank ℚ E ≤ 2 * Module.finrank ℚ F
  rw [← Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ F E]
  calc
    Module.finrank ℚ F * Module.finrank F E ≤ Module.finrank ℚ F * 2 :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left _ hupper
    _ = 2 * Module.finrank ℚ F := Nat.mul_comm _ _

theorem minpoly_sq_degree_dichotomy {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] (α : K) :
    (minpoly ℚ α).natDegree = (minpoly ℚ (α ^ 2)).natDegree ∨
      (minpoly ℚ α).natDegree = 2 * (minpoly ℚ (α ^ 2)).natDegree := by
  have hFE : IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {α ^ 2} ≤ IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {α} := by
    apply IntermediateField.adjoin_simple_le_iff.mpr
    simpa only [pow_two] using (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {α}).mul_mem
      (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ α)
      (IntermediateField.mem_adjoin_simple_self ℚ α)
  have hE := IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank (IsIntegral.of_finite ℚ α)
  have hF := IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank (IsIntegral.of_finite ℚ (α ^ 2))
  have hdvd := IntermediateField.finrank_dvd_of_le_right hFE
  have hbound := adjoin_power_degree_le_two α
  rw [hE, hF] at hdvd hbound
  have hpos := minpoly.natDegree_pos (IsIntegral.of_finite ℚ α)
  have hposSq := minpoly.natDegree_pos (IsIntegral.of_finite ℚ (α ^ 2))
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hdvd
  have hrpos : 0 < r := by
    by_contra h
    have hrzero : r = 0 := by omega
    rw [hr, hrzero, mul_zero] at hpos
    exact (lt_irrefl (0 : ℕ)) hpos
  have hrle : r ≤ 2 := by
    have hmul : (minpoly ℚ (α ^ 2)).natDegree * r ≤
        (minpoly ℚ (α ^ 2)).natDegree * 2 := by
      simpa only [hr, Nat.mul_comm] using hbound
    exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left hmul hposSq
  have hcases : r = 1 ∨ r = 2 := by omega
  rcases hcases with h | h
  · left
    simpa only [h, mul_one] using hr
  · right
    simpa only [h, Nat.mul_comm] using hr

theorem minpoly_sq_comp_of_degree_drop {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K]
    (α : K) (hdrop : (minpoly ℚ (α ^ 2)).natDegree < (minpoly ℚ α).natDegree) :
    (minpoly ℚ (α ^ 2)).comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) = minpoly ℚ α := by
  have hα := IsIntegral.of_finite ℚ α
  have hαsq := IsIntegral.of_finite ℚ (α ^ 2)
  have hdegree : (minpoly ℚ α).natDegree = 2 * (minpoly ℚ (α ^ 2)).natDegree := by
    rcases minpoly_sq_degree_dichotomy α with h | h
    · omega
    · exact h
  have hmonic : ((minpoly ℚ (α ^ 2)).comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2)).Monic :=
    (minpoly.monic hαsq).comp (Polynomial.monic_X_pow 2) (by simp)

theorem even_odd_power_transform_mod_two (F : Polynomial ℤ) :
    ∃ H : Polynomial ℤ,
      (Polynomial.contract 2 F) ^ 2 -
        Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX F)) ^ 2 = F + 2 * H := by
  let T : Polynomial ℤ → Polynomial ℤ := fun P =>
    (Polynomial.contract 2 P) ^ 2 -
      Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX P)) ^ 2
  let f := Int.castRingHom (ZMod 2)
  have hneg : -(Polynomial.X : Polynomial (ZMod 2)) = Polynomial.X := by
    ext n
    simp only [Polynomial.coeff_neg]
    exact ZMod.neg_eq_self_mod_two _
  have hsubst := congrArg (fun P : Polynomial ℤ => P.map f)
    (even_odd_power_transform_subst F)
  change ((T F).comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2)).map f = (F * F.comp (-Polynomial.X)).map f
    at hsubst
  simp only [Polynomial.map_comp, Polynomial.map_pow, Polynomial.map_X,
    Polynomial.map_mul, Polynomial.map_neg, hneg, Polynomial.comp_X] at hsubst
  have hmap : (T F).map f = F.map f := by
    apply Polynomial.expand_injective (by norm_num : 0 < (2 : ℕ))
    change ((T F).map f).comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2) =
      (F.map f).comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2)
    rw [hsubst, ← pow_two]
    simpa only [ZMod.frobenius_zmod, Polynomial.map_id,
      Polynomial.expand_eq_comp_X_pow] using
      (Polynomial.map_frobenius_expand 2 (F.map f)).symm
  have hzero : (T F - F).map f = 0 := by
    rw [Polynomial.map_sub, hmap, sub_self]
  have hdiv : Polynomial.C (2 : ℤ) ∣ T F - F := by

theorem even_odd_power_transform_add_twice (F H : Polynomial ℤ) :
    let T : Polynomial ℤ → Polynomial ℤ := fun P =>
      (Polynomial.contract 2 P) ^ 2 -
        Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX P)) ^ 2
    let A := Polynomial.contract 2 F
    let B := Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX F)
    let E := Polynomial.contract 2 H
    let D := Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX H)
    T (F + 2 * H) = T F + 4 * (A * E + E ^ 2 - Polynomial.X * (B * D + D ^ 2)) := by
  dsimp only
  have hA : Polynomial.contract 2 (F + 2 * H) =
      Polynomial.contract 2 F + 2 * Polynomial.contract 2 H := by
    ext n
    simp [Polynomial.coeff_contract]
  have hB : Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX (F + 2 * H)) =
      Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX F) +
        2 * Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX H) := by
    ext n
    simp [Polynomial.coeff_contract, Polynomial.coeff_divX]
  rw [hA, hB]
  ring

theorem even_odd_power_transform_mod_four (F : Polynomial ℤ) (hF : F.coeff 0 = 1) :
    let T : Polynomial ℤ → Polynomial ℤ := fun P =>
      (Polynomial.contract 2 P) ^ 2 -
        Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX P)) ^ 2
    ∃ Q : Polynomial ℤ, T (T F) = T F + 4 * Q ∧ Q.coeff 0 = 0 := by
  let T : Polynomial ℤ → Polynomial ℤ := fun P =>
    (Polynomial.contract 2 P) ^ 2 -
      Polynomial.X * (Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX P)) ^ 2
  change ∃ Q : Polynomial ℤ, T (T F) = T F + 4 * Q ∧ Q.coeff 0 = 0
  obtain ⟨H, hH⟩ := even_odd_power_transform_mod_two F
  change T F = F + 2 * H at hH
  have hH0 : H.coeff 0 = 0 := by
    have hc := congrArg (fun P : Polynomial ℤ => P.coeff 0) hH
    change (T F).coeff 0 = (F + 2 * H).coeff 0 at hc
    rw [even_odd_power_transform_coeff_zero, hF] at hc
    simp only [one_pow, Polynomial.coeff_add, Polynomial.coeff_ofNat_mul, hF] at hc
    omega
  let Q := Polynomial.contract 2 F * Polynomial.contract 2 H +
    (Polynomial.contract 2 H) ^ 2 - Polynomial.X *
      (Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX F) *
        Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX H) +
          (Polynomial.contract 2 (Polynomial.divX H)) ^ 2)
  refine ⟨Q, ?_, ?_⟩
  · calc
      T (T F) = T (F + 2 * H) := congrArg T hH
      _ = T F + 4 * Q := even_odd_power_transform_add_twice F H
  · simp [Q, pow_two, Polynomial.mul_coeff_zero, Polynomial.coeff_contract, hH0]

theorem rpow_from_nat_power (x : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hn : 0 < n)
    (hpow : (2 : ℝ) ≤ x ^ (4 * n)) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (1 / (4 * (n : ℝ)) : ℝ) ≤ x := by
  have hpos : (0 : ℝ) < 4 * (n : ℝ) :=
    mul_pos (by norm_num) (Nat.cast_pos.mpr hn)
  have hcast : (4 : ℝ) * (n : ℝ) = ((4 * n : ℕ) : ℝ) := by simp
  rw [one_div, Real.rpow_inv_le_iff_of_pos (by norm_num) hx hpos,
    hcast, Real.rpow_natCast]
  exact hpow

# Polynomial Factor Matching Checkpoint

Task `help_f9e206b7fe0e41e49174596683c59e8c`, revision 0, digest
`69a477346b36b5e12d649fb0d1c2018b53397328287b890fc83c4396eef79ea5`.
The assigned polynomial factor matching question is proved over every field,
which includes the requested specialization to rational polynomials.

## Saved Helpers

`Submission.Helpers.polynomial_dvd_of_irreducible_mul_eq_sq`,
`Submission/Helpers.lean:3658`:

```lean
{k : Type*} [Field k] {P Q G : Polynomial k}
(hP : Irreducible P) (hsq : G ^ 2 = P * Q) : P ∣ Q
```

Primality of the irreducible polynomial gives `P ∣ G`. Substitute `G=P*H`,
cancel the nonzero factor `P`, and obtain `Q=P*H^2`.

`Submission.Helpers.polynomial_eq_of_monic_irreducible_mul_eq_sq`,
`Submission/Helpers.lean:3669`:

```lean
{k : Type*} [Field k] {P Q G : Polynomial k}
(hP : P.Monic) (hPirr : Irreducible P) (hQ : Q.Monic)
(hdegree : Q.natDegree = P.natDegree)
(hsq : G ^ 2 = P * Q) : Q = P
```

Apply the preceding divisibility lemma and the library theorem
`Polynomial.eq_of_monic_of_dvd_of_natDegree_le`. Irreducibility of `Q`
is not needed. All inherited declarations, proofs, imports, options and
namespace context are preserved. No probe commands remain.

## Validation

The frozen `check_lean` check of final saved `Submission.lean` passed:
exitCode 0, timedOut false. It compiled Helpers uncached in 31536 ms and
Submission uncached in 6117 ms. Helpers had no diagnostics. Submission
reported only its preserved original `dimitrov` sorry warning.
`git diff --check` passed.

Final Helpers SHA256:
`70fe5882f4b41086aa4ad07b7a19b28a75300b9d0cafae08834e3e4b0d51e178`.
Unchanged Submission SHA256:
`4ccc782999c50bb2bfb202882f675c6c2dc34fa54fbe1609796c781e9177b84e`.
No git commit was created; git metadata is managed by the host.

## Integration And Remaining Gaps

The host should independently check and integrate the two new named helpers,
then specialize the second to the monic reverses of the transform factors.
Their monicity, equal degrees and first-factor irreducibility must still be
established at that application site. No second-factor irreducibility is
required.

All recovered helpers, including argument positivity and exact argument
halving in the degree-drop case, remain in place and compiled in this run.
The original `Submission.dimitrov` remains unproved. Sharp arbitrary-ray
energy, quantitative contraction, reciprocal-minpoly identification and
final number-field/induction integration remain outside this assignment.
Original-target acceptance and independent official local evaluation are
not claimed.
